discrepancy_leads: README 'Security' column is a targeted ASR (security=True = injection succeeded), while the README glosses it as 'resisted' (agentdojo/README.md l.51, 233, 459). Known: profile quirk semantic_trap_security_gloss.

Run scripts as released are not those that produced the logs: --force-rerun was added 2026-08-25 (commit 35f51954) after the last log (2026-08-21); the README says the full run reused cached Phase-1 results. Test via evaluation_timestamp ordering (prereg H4/H5).

README 'partial benchmark' (105 pairs/model) table: if the full run reused the cache, those logs are the partial run and the partial table should reproduce exactly from them; otherwise the partial table is not backed by released data (H4).

README says the gpt-oss 500 error is deterministic on workspace ut26/ut30 and travel ut19, but only 11 run errors exist (10 attacked + workspace injection_task_13 solvability); 35 gpt-oss pairs exist on those tasks (H2, H3). The gpt-oss benign travel ut19 run aborted per README yet should have error null in the released log (H9) — rerun after patch (console_attack_restart.log; restart scripts deleted in 26692cd6).
README gpt-oss combined ASR 27.0% (256/949) includes 10 security=True values imposed by local patch (c) on run errors; excluding them gives 246/939 = 26.2%.
The 105 solvability runs are in the data but not reported by the README (extra arm vs paper).
README total time ~63 h vs summed log duration 65.09 h; per-model check H8.
Model identity rests on directory names only; Ollama tags are mutable and no weight digest is recorded (identity class I).

AgentDojo harness defects at 089ed468 that bias outcomes: #181 banking injection_task_0/1/3 security check reduces to 'any transfer to attacker IBAN' (ASR possibly inflated on banking; H10); #161 banking user_task_5 utility vacuous; #162 workspace user_task_34; #213 workspace injection_task_6..13 have no ground truth (solvability pre-pass of those tasks unverified).

Ollama qwen3-coder parser gap (ollama#18530 open; #17353) explains the 173-174 qwen3-coder runs whose tool call is text and never executed (H6); README's lower qwen3-coder utility partly reflects this, not model capability.
agentdojo#214: tool outputs carry \uXXXX escapes for non-ASCII (H7).

[fact-check addition] agentdojo/README.md contradicts itself on the partial run: its script table marks run_partial_benchmark.sh '(not used in the reported run)' (l.255), while the Phase 1 text (l.349) says the partial benchmark ran first and the full run reused cached results. Both scripts at the pin write the same logdir ../your-results/runs_<slug>, and patch (b) exists for loading cached results.
